svg.text: Projects are funded by a donor; reports and exports group spending by donor.

g.text: Korea Food for the Hungry International
Donor rules (for example KOICA's bidding thresholds) are recorded on the donor and shown to Procurement when they source for that donor's projects.

svg.text: Projects are funded by a donor; it must exist before the project.
